resolution: Phase 5b start: the Blockbench BOX-NET UV layout. Ours shelf-packed 6 separated squares; Blockbench unfolds the cube into the contiguous Minecraft cross net. Added boxNetOffsets in editMesh.ts: when the 6 faces are one-per-axis-sign (a clean box), unwrap() places each face at its net offset — up/down in the top strip, right/front/left/back in the side strip (net width 2*(d+w), height d+h) — normalized into the unit square; anything else (an edited mesh) falls back to the existing shelf packer. cuboid()/cylinder() unwrap at mint so a fresh cube is already a box net. editMesh 25/25 (added a contiguity test asserting up+front share a column and touch, and front+left are adjacent in the side strip). Hot-reload TSX, nothing committed. Remaining 5b: per-face orientation parity with Blockbench + the atlas GUIDE image export; then 5c paint the atlas, 5d image-to-image; selection-scoped UV display still open.
